'''Sector M777''' was an area within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home of the [[501st Central Garrison]] for the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
